goal: Compare two amounts without counting: give one to each and see who is left without (more / fewer), as many when nobody is; a long row is not more; make two amounts as many by adding, taking away or moving one over.
cover: At night on a glade, Fox, Squirrel, Owl and Deer each hold a small glass jar lantern glowing warm yellow with a firefly inside; a few more fireflies glow in the dark blue air around them and a crescent moon smiles in the sky.
